{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}")

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_completed = completed[completed['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Number of loyal customers in completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Compute mean revenue for loyal completed orders
mean_revenue_loyal = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue_loyal}")"}
